# ziti_proxy_v1_config (Data Source)

Ziti proxy v1 config Data Source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ziti_proxy_v1_config" "test_v1_proxy_data" {
  name = "test.proxy.v1"
}

output "ziti_proxy_config" {
  value = data.ziti_proxy_v1_config.test_v1_proxy_data
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier
- `name` (String) Name of the config

### Read-Only

- `binding` (String) The binding to use for this proxy config.
- `config_type_id` (String) The Id of a config-type
- `port` (Number) The port to listen on.
- `protocols` (List of String) Protocols that the proxy will listen on.
- `tags` (Map of String) Config Tags
